review_candidates.title: Project Coordinator
review_candidates.description: St. John's, NL The Cahill Group is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to join our Construction NL team in St. John’s, NL. Reporting to the Project Manager, you will play an integral role in supporting the successful execution of industrial construction projects from planning through completion. In this fast-paced and hands-on role, you will work closely with project managers, site supervision, tradespeople, clients, consultants, and subcontractors to help deliver projects safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget. You will have the opportunity to spend time in the field, identifying and resolving challenges, improving project coordination, and contributing to a strong culture of safety and operational excellence. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and enjoys working in a collaborative environment where problem-solving, communication, and attention to detail are key to project success. This position offers an exciting opportunity to gain exposure to all phases of project delivery while building valuable experience in project coordination, planning, cost control, procurement, scheduling, and construction management. This position will be a permanent position, working Monday to Friday, with opportunities for travel and rotational site assignments that may arise. What will you do? Support the successful delivery of construction projects by helping ensure work is completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with client expectations and contract requirements. Coordinate the planning and execution of project activities by ensuring materials, equipment, and skilled trades personnel are available and aligned with project timelines. Serve as a vital link between the field and office, maintaining project documentation, submittals, records, and reporting systems that keep projects running smoothly. Review project drawings, specifications, and scopes of work, assisting with material take-offs, equipment planning, and procurement activities. Champion a strong safety culture by helping identify potential hazards, supporting risk mitigation plans, and promoting health, safety, and environmental excellence across all project activities. Participate in toolbox talks, safety meetings, and training initiatives to help ensure every team member returns home safely each day. Collaborate with project supervisors and managers to develop work plans, schedules, resource allocations, and productivity improvement initiatives. Assist in coordinating daily construction activities and sequencing work to maximize efficiency while minimizing disruptions to ongoing operations. Track project progress, gather field data, and contribute to regular project reporting that supports informed decision-making. Support the engagement and coordination of subcontractors, helping ensure work is completed to project standards and client requirements. Play an active role in managing project changes, requests for information (RFIs), change orders, shop drawings, and other key project controls. Monitor project registers and proactively follow up on outstanding items to help prevent delays and maintain project momentum. Build strong working relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and project teams, fostering collaboration and effective communication. Respond promptly to project inquiries and help ensure critical information flows efficiently between all stakeholders. Contribute to successful project closeout activities, including turnover packages, final documentation, and handover deliverables. What will you bring? An Engineering Degree or Engineering Technology diploma or equivalent combination of training and experience. Focus in electrical and mechanical areas are preferred. 3+ years of experience in construction, industrial, maintenance, or project coordination environments. Experience working in industrial, mining, energy, commercial, or heavy civil construction environments is an asset. Must be able to communicate effectively with management, tradespersons, clients and suppliers. Strong organizational skills Proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite of programs and adaptable to other software applications as required The Cahill Group is one of the largest multi-disciplinary construction companies in Canada. Cahill is building the future of energy, mining, hydro, and social infrastructure on some of the largest construction and fabrication project sites in the country. People really are at the heart of everything we do. So, we will always put the health, well-being, and safety of our people above all. We take care of our people, through investment, training, competitive compensation, health plan benefits, and unique programs to support the health and well-being of you and your family. We believe that a diverse and inclusive culture creates a work environment that is supportive, engaging and rewarding. We welcome, recognize, and celebrate diverse backgrounds, cultures, demographics, perspectives, and experiences within our team. Being you at The Cahill Group is what makes us stronger and enables innovation and creativity in meeting tomorrow’s challenges. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer actively seeking to recruit a diverse and talented workforce. If you require any accommodation in the recruitment process, please let us know. While we thank all applicants for their interest, only those under consideration will be contacted. Location St. John's, NL Apply now Back

review_candidates.company: Centre for Oncology and Immunology Limited
review_candidates.location: Tai Po District, Hong Kong SAR
review_candidates.description: Organisational background The long-term objective of the Centre for Oncology and Immunology is to employ novel functional screens, animal and cell models including organoids, immuno-oncology approaches, as well as advanced genomic and proteomic techniques down to single-cell resolution to identify novel “druggable” cancer targets for hard-to-treat malignancies. The ultimate goal is to develop therapeutics against these targets and to conduct clinical trials evaluating these drugs along with biomarkers with an eye to their eventual commercialization worldwide. Success in this venture will address pressing unmet medical needs and establish Hong Kong as a leading hub of innovative anti-cancer and immuno-oncology drug development. Job responsibilities Applicants are expected to contribute to collaborative research projects focused on the discovery of cancer biomarkers using large-scale multi-omics approaches, organoid technologies, and novel animal models, as well as the development of anti-cancer or immuno-oncology drugs. Qualifications and skills Applicants should demonstrate a strong interest in cancer immunotherapy and mechanisms underlying therapeutic resistance. A solid academic background in Biomedical Sciences, Bioengineering, or Biological Sciences is required, with preference for candidates trained in Cancer Biology, Immunology, Immuno-oncology, Molecular Biology, Genomics, Proteomics, Metabolomics, Bioinformatics, Single-Cell Technologies, or Medicinal Chemistry. Applicants should possess the following skill sets: a) Postdoctoral Fellow (Ref No. 103499/A) Demonstrated track record of publishing academic research papers Strong research focus in one or more of the following areas: immunology, oncology, molecular genetics, integrative genomics, T-cell-based immunotherapies, immuno-oncology, T-cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma, multi-omics profiling, bioinformatics, cancer metabolism, tumour microenvironment, or drug discovery Extensive experience in molecular biology laboratory techniques, including mammalian cell culture, animal handling, mouse models and xenograft models Experience with CRISPR Cas9 technology, high-throughput screening approaches, and single-cell sequencing technologies will be an asset b) Research Associate (Ref No. 103499/B)/ Research Assistant (Ref No. 103499/C) The appointees are expected to assist senior researchers in carrying out experiments in collaborative research projects. Advanced qualified appointees will be further trained and assigned to carry out independent research projects Strong laboratory and technical skills, with the ability to plan and execute experiments independently in coordination with senior researchers Prior experience in a medical or academic research laboratory environment is preferred; experience within local universities or research core facilities will be considered an advantage Applicants should have a good command of written and spoken English, strong communication skills, and be self-motivated, proactive and able to work well in an interdisciplinary team. The appointees shall work in Hong Kong Science and Technology Park. Overseas graduates are welcome to apply, the qualification-awarding institution should be among the top 100 institutions for STEM-related subjects in QS, Shanghai Jiao Tong University or Times Higher Education world university rankings. Applicants for the Postdoctoral fellow position should possess a Ph.D. degree or an equivalent qualification in one of the said relevant disciplines. (Ref No. 103499/A) Applicants for the Research Associate position should possess a master’s degree or an equivalent qualification in one of the said relevant disciplines. Applicants for the Research Assistant position should possess a bachelor’s degree or an equivalent qualification in one of the said relevant disciplines. A highly competitive salary commensurate with qualifications and experience will be offered, complemented by generous annual leave, medical benefits, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic and well-resourced research environment. How to apply Applicants should submit their up-to-date CV, letter of motivation, and a research publication list, quoting the job reference number, with information of current/expected remuneration and availability, to career@coinno.hk. Review of applications will commence as soon as possible or until the posts are filled, whichever is earlier. The personal data provided in your application process will be used for recruitment and other employment-related purposed. The personal data may be transferred and disclosed to, and used by HKU Innovation Holdings Limited and The University of Hong Kong for the above purposes. We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

review_candidates.title: Planificador de Proyectos
review_candidates.description: Description Descripción del Puesto. El planificador jugará un papel clave para asegurar que los proyectos de Ingeniería, Adquisiciones y Construcción se lleven a cabo con éxito, desarrollando y manteniendo cronogramas de proyecto completos, coordinando con diferentes partes interesadas y detectando y mitigando posibles riesgos de tiempo. Este rol requiere mucha atención al detalle, habilidades de organización sólidas y la capacidad de comunicarte efectivamente con equipos de distintas áreas para garantizar que los hitos del proyecto se cumplan a tiempo y dentro del presupuesto. Funciones. Desarrollar y mantener cronogramas de proyectos detallados utilizando software de gestión de proyectos, asegurando que estén alineados con los requisitos, hitos y plazos del proyecto. Colaborar con los gerentes de proyecto, ingenieros, especialistas en adquisiciones y equipos de construcción para recopilar datos relevantes del proyecto e incorporarlos en el cronograma. Analizar el alcance del proyecto, los entregables y los requisitos de recursos para identificar dependencias, rutas críticas y posibles conflictos de programación. Monitorear el progreso en relación con el cronograma del proyecto, identificar desviaciones y recomendar de manera proactiva acciones correctivas para mantener el proyecto en marcha. Coordinar con subcontratistas y proveedores para integrar sus cronogramas con la línea de tiempo general del proyecto y asegurar la entrega oportuna de materiales y servicios. Realizar reuniones periódicas de progreso con los equipos de proyecto para revisar el desempeño del cronograma, abordar desafíos y comunicar los próximos hitos. Preparar y distribuir informes de estado del proyecto, diagramas de Gantt y otra documentación relacionada con el cronograma a las partes interesadas según sea necesario. Anticipar y mitigar posibles riesgos del cronograma identificando señales de alerta tempranas, desarrollando planes de contingencia y comunicando estrategias de mitigación de riesgos al equipo del proyecto. Mejorar continuamente los procesos y procedimientos de programación para aumentar la eficiencia y efectividad del proyecto. Brindar apoyo durante las fases de planificación y ejecución del proyecto, incluyendo ayudar con la asignación de recursos, el seguimiento del presupuesto y la gestión del alcance cuando sea necesario. Requirements Requerimientos. Más de 6 años de experiencia en la gestión y control de proyectos energéticos (preferiblemente en petróleo y gas, transporte de gas natural). Experiencia en oleoductos y/o CS. Experiencia en planificación y control de progreso de proyectos EPC en el sector energético. Experiencia en obras civiles y electromecánicas. Conocimiento de las necesidades y requerimientos de proyectos de energía e infraestructura, Indicadores Clave de Desempeño y metodologías PMI. Nivel avanzado de Excel, con dominio demostrado en software de planificación de proyectos (por ejemplo, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project) y comprensión de técnicas de programación, análisis de ruta crítica y nivelación de recursos. Experiencia en análisis de ratios e indicadores de trabajo. PMI o AACEI metodologies knowledge, CPM, PERT Formación. Ingeniero Profesional Industrial, Mecánico o Civil. Habilidades. Comunicación efectiva Resolución de problemas Habilidades interpersonales Gestión del tiempo Organizado y estructurado Atención al detalle Adaptabilidad Habilidades analíticas Pensamiento crítico Capacidad para trabajar en equipos multidisciplinarios en la organización Proactivo, manejo del estrés.
